title: Handling Missing Responses under Cluster Dependence with Applications to Language Model Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing statistical methodology (specifically doubly robust estimators) for handling missing human annotations in clustered data, such as LLM evaluation. While it utilizes datasets containing labels like toxicity and mentions alignment with human preferences, its primary contribution is a mathematical/statistical method for estimation rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or specific ethical frameworks.
bias_targets: Hate speech detection (general toxic or hateful content)
